name: Do Once
description: Lets execution pass through a single time, then blocks every subsequent call until its Reset input fires. Commonly used to ensure setup logic, a sound cue, or a one-time event triggers only once.

inputs.name: In
inputs.description: Execution pin that may pass through once. Connect any exec output that should only trigger the body once.

inputs.name: Reset
inputs.description: Resets the internal flag of the node so it can be triggered again. Connect to a respawn, retry, or level reload event.

inputs.name: Start Closed
inputs.description: If true, the node starts in the already-triggered state. Completed will not pulse until Reset is called.

outputs.name: Completed
outputs.description: Pulsed output once the node is triggered (only the first time, until Reset). Connect the one-time body here.
